verdict.rationale: Sketch's prototyping docs cover overlays, hover, press and toggle triggers, and scrolling areas, which address the scroll-effects and interactive-trigger parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents animated transitions between states, or conditional logic and variables in prototypes, so only about half the story is supported. Missing for 10: animation/transitions between states, conditions or variables, independent or hands-on corroboration of advanced prototype fidelity.

support.subject: As a designer, prototypes can carry advanced behavior — animation between states, conditions or variables, scroll effects — to feel like the real product

citations.quote: With features like overlays, hover, press and toggle triggers, and scrolling areas, you can accurately show how your designs would work in the real world — and on any device.
Show Overlays (e.g. menus, dropdowns or dialogs) that appear when you click, press or hover over another layer.
Create links or Hotspots to navigate between different frames or trigger Overlays.
